intro_en: A workplace report answers three questions fast: are we on track, what moved, and what needs attention next. Targets give every number a meaning.
intro_zh: 职场报告要快速回答三个问题：进度是否正常、什么发生了变化、接下来该关注什么。有了目标值，数字才有意义。

examples: Revenue ended at 194, above the 190 target.

moves.name_en: Report the change over the period
Flag the miss without hiding it
moves.name_zh: 如实指出没达标的一项
examples: p95 response time improved but still misses the 320 target.
Acquisition and response time need attention this week.

worked.en: This KPI table tracks four weekly metrics against target. Revenue ended at 194, above the 190 target, after starting the quarter at 168. New customers improved from 1240 to 1450 but remain short of the 1500 target. Churn reached 4.0, exactly on target, while p95 response time improved from 380 to 332 but still misses the 320 target. The headline for the ops review is that revenue and churn are on track, while acquisition and response time need attention.
worked.zh: 这张指标表按周追踪四个指标相对目标的表现。收入从季度初的 168 提升到 194，高于 190 的目标。新客户从 1240 增加到 1450，但仍低于 1500 的目标。流失率降到 4.0，正好达标；p95 响应时间从 380 改善到 332，但仍未达到 320 的目标。运营复盘的结论是：收入和流失率在轨道上，获客和响应时间需要关注。

pitfalls_zh: 只写“完成得很好”没有意义，要给出目标值和差距。
同比（year on year）和环比（quarter on quarter）要写清楚，不能只说“增长了”。
不要用 improved 掩盖方向错误：响应时间下降是 improved，收入下降不是。
指标单位不同不要放在同一句里直接比较大小。
